reportedBy.subject: retained text materialization
reportedBy.scenario: two fonts reuse the same glyph id

expected.behavior: Glyph geometry cache identity includes the exact font and glyph so different fonts cannot share incompatible outlines.

actual.behavior: The static glyph cache is keyed only by gid; a diagnostic probe produced identical geometry for two fonts with the same gid and different outlines.

evidence.proves: Cache lookup and insertion use gid without font identity.

minimalReproduction.source: Create two fake fonts that return the same gid but different outlines, then construct Text geometry for each.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert the second geometry differs from the first; current code returns the first geometry.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Changing glyph ids in Renderer or components

reportedBy.subject: image materialization
reportedBy.scenario: same source is requested on two GPUDevice owners

expected.reference: WebGPU resource-device ownership and @engine/core texture contract
expected.behavior: Every cached GPUTexture and fallback texture belongs to the exact GPUDevice that created it.

actual.behavior: TextureLoader caches by src and one process-global fallback; a second device can receive the first device's texture.

evidence.proves: Cache and fallback identity are global rather than GPUDevice-scoped.

minimalReproduction.source: Request the fallback or same src from fake device A and then fake device B.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert each device creates and receives its own texture; current code returns A's texture to B.

expected.behavior: Disposing the Engine renderer releases device-owned buffers, attachments, cached texture/text resources, callbacks and subscriptions exactly once.

actual.behavior: Renderer exposes geometry invalidation but no whole-owner dispose; TextureLoader caches/listeners and evicted Text GPU buffers have no complete teardown path.

evidence.proves: Global caches and callback sets have no clear/dispose/unsubscribe owner API.

minimalReproduction.source: Create a renderer, materialize text/images/pipelines, dispose the browser runtime and inspect retained Engine cache/resource owners.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert all owner resources and callbacks are released exactly once.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Browser runtime reaching into private Engine maps

expected.reference: Accepted one semantic tree / CPU Renderer CSS ownership law
expected.behavior: Engine public objects contain only scene, GPU and resource state; DOM/CSS layout semantics remain in CPU Renderer.

actual.behavior: Object3D publicly exposes layout/computedLayout and @engine/core exports CSS-like flex/sizing/gap/padding/margin types.

evidence.proves: CSS-like layout state is publicly attached to Engine scene objects.
evidence.doesNotProve: Whether any current consumer still uses the fields.

minimalReproduction.source: Import LayoutProps or assign Object3D.layout from @engine/core.
minimalReproduction.test: A package-boundary test should reject DOM/CSS semantic exports from Engine.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Creating a second layout tree on Object3D

expected.behavior: Engine receives host-neutral inputs/resources; browser document/canvas/listener ownership stays in renderer-browser.

actual.behavior: ViewPoint now has a listener-free host mode with explicit client viewport, but default browser controls still accept/mutate HTMLElement state and Renderer.init still owns an HTMLCanvasElement/GPUCanvasContext boundary.

evidence.proves: Host controls avoid browser listeners/element mutation while the default compatibility mode retains an element-owned control path.

minimalReproduction.source: Create ViewPoint for an element in a secondary Document and inspect listener owner and restored touchAction after disposal.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert listeners bind ownerDocument and browser state is restored or entirely browser-owner controlled.

expected.behavior: Only Uint16/Uint32 index buffers reach GPU submission and their declared format matches the underlying data.

actual.behavior: BufferGeometry accepts arbitrary TypedArray indices and GLTF admits UNSIGNED_BYTE, while Renderer binds every non-Uint32 index as uint16 without validation.

evidence.doesNotProve: Actual GPU validation outcome for every array type.

minimalReproduction.source: Create geometry with Uint8Array or Float32Array indices and submit it.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert construction fails closed before GPU submission or binds a valid matching index representation.

reportedBy.subject: quantum/bulk DOM overlay
reportedBy.scenario: HUD composition over the existing 3D scene

expected.behavior: The consumer creates a shared browser-owned overlay and supplies its exact Document/root/style contract.

actual.behavior: Bulk directly constructs CPU Renderer and WebGPU backend and reimplements pointer mapping, hit, pointer capture, touch suppression and lifecycle.

evidence.proves: A second browser-composition implementation exists in the consumer.
evidence.doesNotProve: Whether every branch is currently reachable.

minimalReproduction.source: Compare Bulk overlay-runtime ownership with RendererBrowserSpaceRuntime.addOverlay.
minimalReproduction.test: A package-boundary test should reject direct @zavx0z/renderer and renderer-webgpu imports from the Bulk DOM consumer.

expected.behavior: A consumer reads a neutral documented diagnostic or does not inspect backend internals.

actual.behavior: Demo reads journalPlane.backend.root.children directly, exposing retained WebGPU/Engine owner objects to product code.

evidence.doesNotProve: That the diagnostic is required in production.

minimalReproduction.source: Run the Demo journal plane subscription and inspect the dataset write.
minimalReproduction.test: A consumer-boundary test should reject backend/root/Engine object reads from product code.

expected.behavior: Consumer build configurations compile governed TSX and mount compiled components through @zavx0z/react.

actual.behavior: Demo, Interpreter and MetaFor visual consumers lack JSX compiler settings and still import removed create*Controller APIs.

evidence.proves: Current consumer typecheck fails first with TS6142 and then missing create*Controller exports when JSX is enabled diagnostically.

minimalReproduction.source: Run current Demo/Interpreter/@internal/visual/Bulk typechecks against linked @ui/components.
minimalReproduction.test: Expect no TS6142 and no imports of removed imperative controllers after the consumer migration.

reportedBy.subject: SourceEditor scrollToLine
reportedBy.scenario: scroll a rendered line into view

expected.behavior: A semantic Element can read the current CPU Renderer box without creating a second tree.

actual.behavior: Current canonical DOM has no getBoundingClientRect/readComputedStyle realm bridge; SourceEditor uses line*16 and a fixed 220px viewport.

evidence.proves: The consumer uses fixed geometry because no public read exists.
evidence.doesNotProve: The accepted generic read API shape.

minimalReproduction.source: Change source-editor font size/line height and invoke scrollToLine.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert scrolling uses the current rendered line box rather than a constant.

expected.behavior: A generic path/vector display item carries paint order, clipping, transform and retained identity through WebGPU without Node-specific semantics.

actual.behavior: RenderFrame admits Rect/Text/Image only; Node code hand-builds orthogonal rectangles/points and local placement/culling formulas.

evidence.doesNotProve: That all layout formulas belong in the platform.

minimalReproduction.source: Render one routed link with pan/zoom/clip and stable node endpoint identities.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert a generic path display item preserves geometry/order/clip/hit metadata without Node-specific branches.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Manual Rect decomposition as a hidden permanent fallback

reportedBy.subject: native linked author theme
reportedBy.scenario: an explicitly supplied loaded theme contains @import or @font-face

expected.behavior: A linked author stylesheet either carries imported/resource rules through their true owners or rejects the complete source before semantic publication.

actual.behavior: The bounded host accepts flat CSSStyleRule records only and fails closed for @import, @font-face and other at-rules; it performs no second fetch and owns no Engine font loader.

evidence.symbol: fails closed for unreadable, imported, font and nested CSS
evidence.proves: @import and @font-face reject atomically while the last valid semantic snapshot remains unchanged.
evidence.doesNotProve: A future import graph or font-resource owner.

minimalReproduction.source: Pass an exact loaded link whose cssRules contain CSSImportRule or CSSFontFaceRule to the linked author stylesheet host.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert host.ready/refresh rejects and no partial author snapshot is published.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: A second consumer fetch of the same CSS URL
Copying imported rules or font declarations into component CSS

reportedBy.subject: native linked author theme
reportedBy.scenario: an explicitly supplied theme contains nested selectors

expected.behavior: Nested rules preserve parent selector expansion, source order, specificity and pseudo behavior before semantic cascade.

actual.behavior: The current CPU parser admits flat rules only; the linked host detects nested CSSStyleRule blocks and rejects the source atomically rather than flattening them incorrectly.

evidence.proves: Nested rules do not partially enter the semantic author registry.

minimalReproduction.source: Load a configured link containing button { &:hover { color:red } }.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert refresh rejects with a nesting diagnostic and retains the previous exact snapshot.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Regex flattening in a component or Storybook consumer

reportedBy.subject: foundation theme dimensional tokens
reportedBy.scenario: a component dimension uses min(), max(), clamp() or mixed-unit calc

expected.behavior: Theme dimensions evaluate supported CSS math with compatible unit algebra and containing-block resolution.

actual.behavior: Bounded calc() supports one compatible number/px/percent/resolved-em result; min(), max(), clamp() and mixed percent-plus-pixel sums reject instead of approximating.

evidence.symbol: does not silently admit min max clamp or mixed-unit calc
evidence.proves: Unsupported math values do not produce a computed dimension.
evidence.doesNotProve: A future linear length-percentage representation or min/max/clamp evaluator.

minimalReproduction.source: Set width:min(10px,20px), height:max(...), clamp(...) and calc(100% - 4px) on a semantic Element.
minimalReproduction.test: Assert current computed dimensions are absent and a future implementation resolves each without component-local arithmetic.

forbiddenLocalWorkarounds: Computing layout tokens in component JavaScript

contradictions.title: React compatibility manifest claims completeness but lists only a selected subset
contradictions.claim: requirements.md says the manifest marks every feature supported or unsupported.
contradictions.fact: The prior hand-written manifest contains 25 features and 19 hooks, omitting most React/ReactDOM 19.2 public APIs and two required architecture flags.
contradictions.impact: Compatibility consumers could infer support from absence or treat a partial list as complete.

contradictions.title: DOM SUPPORT still names an optional React custom renderer
contradictions.claim: An optional React custom renderer is an integration path.
contradictions.fact: Current architecture uses compiled @zavx0z/react and explicitly excludes npm React, reconciler, Fiber and a custom React renderer.
contradictions.impact: The document points future work toward a removed architecture.

contradictions.title: MIGRATION.md still promises React adapter/reconciler hooks
contradictions.claim: A React adapter and reconciler/DevTools hook remain migration targets.
contradictions.fact: The current compiled runtime has no npm React/reconciler/Fiber/React DevTools integration.
contradictions.impact: Historical migration text conflicts with the accepted owner graph.

contradictions.title: PERFORMANCE.md numbers are historical and two documented benchmark routes are broken
contradictions.claim: Documented renderer/transform numbers describe the current checkout.
contradictions.fact: The document predates major retained-instancing changes; renderer.ts and transform.ts fail module resolution for @zavx0z/renderer.
contradictions.impact: Historical performance claims cannot be used as current acceptance.

contradictions.title: Detached web-realm acceptance is absent from canonical main
contradictions.claim: Document-bound DOMRect/readComputedStyle/browser evidence exists in Renderer.
contradictions.fact: Current main has no packages/web-realm, realm-host.ts, dom-rect.ts, readComputedStyle or getBoundingClientRect implementation.
contradictions.impact: Historical browser proof must not promote current capabilities.

contradictions.title: Template static parse claims first html block but slices through the last backtick
contradictions.claim: parse() analyzes the first html tagged template.
contradictions.fact: extractMainHtmlBlock starts at the first html tag and ends at the final backtick; a two-template probe returned nodes from both blocks.
contradictions.impact: Static analysis can merge unrelated tagged templates.

contradictions.title: Template README says domain semantics are external while static parser hardcodes MetaFor terms
contradictions.fact: The static parser hardcodes meta-*, fields, mass, energy and update descriptors and sometimes logs/degrades unsupported methods.
contradictions.impact: The source-analysis DSL is not the same neutral contract as the DOM/compiled runtimes.

contradictions.title: Mesh material-array documentation names geometry.groups that do not exist
contradictions.claim: Material arrays map to BufferGeometry groups.
contradictions.fact: BufferGeometry has no groups and Renderer selects material[0].
contradictions.impact: Public documentation promises an unimplemented draw contract.

contradictions.title: renderer-browser marks Engine optional while its root statically imports Engine
contradictions.fact: The main browser entry exports modules with runtime Engine imports and cannot load without Engine.

contradictions.title: Hit metadata disabledness is narrower than semantic disabledness
contradictions.fact: HitMetadata.disabled reads the element's own disabled attribute while :disabled and activation also consider disabled fieldset ancestry.
contradictions.impact: Metadata may say interactive even when semantic default action/focus is suppressed.

contradictions.title: Consumers import removed imperative UI controllers
contradictions.claim: Demo, Interpreter and MetaFor visual packages consume current @ui/components exports.
contradictions.fact: The package exports compiled .tsx components; consumer typechecks fail on JSX configuration and missing create*Controller exports.
contradictions.impact: Current product consumers do not build; restoring controllers would revive the removed architecture.

contradictions.title: Bulk duplicates browser composition ownership
contradictions.claim: renderer-browser is the single browser composition owner.
contradictions.fact: Bulk directly creates CPU Renderer/WebGPU and copies pointer/capture/hit/lifecycle behavior.
contradictions.impact: Two owners can diverge on exact Document/input/presentation lifecycle.

contradictions.title: Node presentation invents fallback placement and route geometry
contradictions.claim: Components consume owner layout and do not compensate for missing platform behavior with manual geometry.
contradictions.fact: NodeSystem/node-editor contain fallback placement, socket endpoint formulas, culling and rectangle/point link decomposition.
contradictions.impact: Domain layout law and missing generic vector presentation are hidden inside a component.

contradictions.title: Demo reads private retained backend owner objects
contradictions.claim: Consumers receive DOM/CSS/TSX and neutral diagnostics, not Surface/Engine/private materializers.
contradictions.impact: A product depends on backend materialization shape.

contradictions.title: Current UI and Node Storybook checkouts reference missing local modules
contradictions.claim: Focused Storybook typechecks are green consumer evidence.
contradictions.fact: The final current-checkout Storybook typechecks fail with TS2307 for multiple missing compiled production story, DOM story, asset and node story modules. Nodes UI also has one owner-route assertion mismatch: /references/ was expected while the current source emits /__storybook/resources/nodes/.... These failures appeared in concurrent owner WIP and are not platform implementation evidence.
contradictions.impact: Current Storybook routes cannot be used as final browser/component acceptance until their owner WIP is completed.

historicalClaims.notes: Memory benchmark evidence only; it does not establish DOM conformance.

historicalClaims.evidence: packages/dom/src/node.ts, element.ts, event-target.ts and specialized control fields allocate optional state on demand.
historicalClaims.notes: The exact byte effect varies by node kind and title/control state.

historicalClaims.claim: Supported DOM classes preserve their exact prototype chains.
historicalClaims.evidence: DOM structural/control tests assert exact specialized constructor/prototype identity.
historicalClaims.notes: Only the currently specialized element map; arbitrary standard tags may still be generic HTMLElement.

historicalClaims.claim: The platform has one semantic tree.
historicalClaims.evidence: Document/Node mutation path feeds CPU Renderer and retained backend without a second semantic or virtual tree.
historicalClaims.notes: Engine still exposes legacy CSS-like layout fields, recorded as a P0 ownership contradiction.

historicalClaims.notes: A benchmark path, not a universal dirty-frame guarantee.

historicalClaims.evidence: WebGPU backend tests prove scalar (node,key) owners and instanced generation-guarded stable slots across admitted updates.
historicalClaims.notes: Topology/overlap/clip/capacity changes can intentionally rebuild plans or fall back scalar.

historicalClaims.claim: A hidden native input/textarea host exists.
historicalClaims.evidence: DocumentNativeInputHost and 39 Browser package tests cover the bounded proxy/rollback path.
historicalClaims.notes: No live browser IME/caret/pixel acceptance was reproduced.

historicalClaims.claim: Native input projection retains the exact semantic Document identity.
historicalClaims.evidence: Browser adapter tests assert exact Document/owner routing.
historicalClaims.notes: The historical detached web-realm live browser proof is not current canonical evidence.

historicalClaims.claim: HTMLElement.title and explicit-empty inherited title suppression work.
historicalClaims.evidence: DOM reflection and Core interaction tests prove nearest present title, empty suppression and deterministic UA overlay.
historicalClaims.notes: Not full native tooltip or accessible-name parity.

historicalClaims.claim: Scroll, clip, input and form-control slices exist.
historicalClaims.evidence: DOM/Core/WebGPU focused tests cover requested/applied scroll, clip stacks, text proxy and bounded control paint.
historicalClaims.notes: No complete forms, picker, caret/selection paint, clipboard, range drag/keyboard or all downstream clip combinations.

historicalClaims.claim: TSX compiles without JSX descriptors, Fiber or a virtual DOM.
historicalClaims.evidence: Template compiler/runtime/boundary tests and @zavx0z/react dependency boundary prove the fixed-slot compiled ABI and reject npm React/reconciler.
historicalClaims.notes: Browser-target build is tested; live browser execution was not reproduced in this audit.
